bundle.shortDescription: Consent-first email on the mailbox you already have
bundle.longDescription: ohmail is consent-first email on the mailboxes you already have. It connects to your own IMAP mail server over TLS, mirrors your mailbox to a database on this computer, and organises new mail into ohmail/ folders on the server itself, where every other mail app you own can see it. First-time senders wait in the Screener until you say where they belong. The app carries its own mail engine and its own Node runtime; nothing but your mail server and the signed update check is contacted.
